scope: Performance and scientific-integrity risks to measure before FAST_CORE implementation.

verified_code_level_findings.finding: When the 24 groups are executed as separate worker invocations, each invocation recomputes the complete 804672-config ordered root before processing its 33528-config group.
verified_code_level_findings.evidence: qros_seed0076_ga1_shard_worker_v223.py process(): full nested bases x filter_packages config_id loop occurs before only_group_index filtering.

verified_code_level_findings.finding: filter_packages, package_partition, base rows and structural cache are rebuilt inside every separate group worker invocation.
verified_code_level_findings.evidence: process() constructs fps/bases/parts and calls build_structural_cache before group selection.

verified_code_level_findings.finding: group_packages_exact computes zlib.compress(p.tobytes(),1) but never uses the compressed result, while p.tobytes() is invoked repeatedly.
Ephemeral per-group ClassDB uses SQLite journal_mode=DELETE and synchronous=FULL, then the DB is deleted after finalization.
verified_code_level_findings.evidence: ClassDB.__init__ and process() cleanup in worker v223.
verified_code_level_findings.semantic_value: Crash protection inside scratch only; final scientific evidence is exported separately.

verified_code_level_findings.finding: Merge uses synchronous=FULL scratch SQLite and rehashes all 72 group artifacts; independent merge oracle re-reads/re-hashes group artifacts again.
verified_code_level_findings.scientific_value: Independent integrity check is valuable; physical reread strategy may be optimizable without weakening the oracle.

verified_code_level_findings.finding: M12 materializes multi-gigabyte intermediate mask representations before compaction.

high_confidence_hypotheses_requiring_mea.hypothesis: NPZ-based indicator and tick caches may cause repeated archive array materialization/copy across 24 short-lived processes rather than true persistent mmap reuse.
high_confidence_hypotheses_requiring_mea.required_measurement: RSS, load time, page/block I/O, repeated array-access cost.

high_confidence_hypotheses_requiring_mea.hypothesis: Candidate/retest/rearm Numba kernels may still dominate CPU despite control-plane/I/O inefficiencies.
high_confidence_hypotheses_requiring_mea.required_measurement: cProfile/phase timing around raw-cache and filter_raw_to_candidates; do not optimize I/O only.

high_confidence_hypotheses_requiring_mea.hypothesis: Package-mask DAG/common-subexpression evaluation can reduce repeated bitwise AND and unpackbits work.
A persistent per-shard process with adaptive checkpoints may outperform 24 process invocations primarily by reusing immutable caches and JIT/import state.
high_confidence_hypotheses_requiring_mea.required_measurement: cold vs warm group panel and full-shard baseline.

benchmark_validity_risks.control: Use instrumentation=off for performance timing; use cprofile only for attribution. Never compare cProfile wall time to optimized unprofiled wall time.

benchmark_validity_risks.risk: Numba cold compilation and OS page cache can dominate a single run.
benchmark_validity_risks.control: Record cold run separately; benchmark warm steady-state with repeated runs and report median plus dispersion before claiming speedup.

benchmark_validity_risks.risk: Different CPUs/BLAS/thread counts make wall-clock comparisons invalid.
benchmark_validity_risks.control: Record environment and pin thread env. Compare baseline/candidate on same runtime and data cache state.

benchmark_validity_risks.risk: Optimization can alter float comparison outcomes at threshold boundaries.
benchmark_validity_risks.control: No fastmath/unordered numeric rewrite without exact M12 mask/config-to-class/root parity. Preserve operation order unless independently proven equivalent.

scientific_integrity_risks.risk: DEV exact-mask equivalence and causal/genealogical equivalence are different concepts.
scientific_integrity_risks.current_contract: Within SEED0076 first-gate multiplicity, one distinct exact GA1 event-mask class per shard is the frozen hypothesis test unit.
scientific_integrity_risks.future_improvement: Retain a separate CAUSAL_PROVENANCE_CLASS_ID in future universes so computational mask sharing never erases mechanism provenance. Optionally run a conservative multiplicity sensitivity using causal-class count; it cannot rescue a failed gate.

scientific_integrity_risks.risk: A project-global cache can silently reuse stale artifacts after semantic or implementation changes.
scientific_integrity_risks.rule: Cache hit requires exact semantic key identity; otherwise recompute.

scientific_integrity_risks.risk: A faster physical mask representation can change canonical identity.
scientific_integrity_risks.rule: Physical SPARSE/DENSE representation may vary, but canonical event source-index sequence and final SHA-256 identity must remain exact.

prohibited: No FAST_CORE rewrite before measured baseline.
No current multiplicity-contract change as a side effect of performance optimization.
No merge to main before parity and benchmark evidence.
